## Role to permissions

| Role | Count | Permissions |
|---|--:|---|
| `STUDENT` | 6 | `exam:take`, `flashcard:study`, `quiz:practice`, `study_room:join`, `word_family:read`, `word_family:save` |
| `TEACHER` | 17 | `ai:generate`, `ai_chat:use`, `content:share`, `document:upload`, `exam_result:view`, `exam_room:manage`, `exam_session:manage`, `flashcardset:manage`, `quizset:manage`, `study_room:create`, `study_room:join`, `subscription:manage`, `user:search`, `wallet:use`, `word_family:generate`, `word_family:read`, `word_family:save` |
| `SYSTEM_ADMIN` | 9 | `admin:access`, `audit:read`, `finance:admin`, `logs:read`, `page_config:manage`, `role:assign`, `stats:read`, `user:manage`, `word_family:admin` |

## Permission to gateway routes

Routes whose `permissions` list names the permission (the gateway requires ALL listed). Services enforce per-handler declarations on top of this.

### `admin:access`

| Route id | Upstream | Auth | Path | Methods |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `admin` | admin | required | `/api/v1/admin*` | all |

### `ai:generate`

| Route id | Upstream | Auth | Path | Methods |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ai` | content | required | `/api/v1/ai*` | all |
| `ai-upload-history` | content | required | `/api/v1/ai/upload/[^/]+/history` | all |

### `ai_chat:use`

| Route id | Upstream | Auth | Path | Methods |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ai-chat` | aichat | required | `/api/v1/ai-chat*` | all |
| `ai-chat-stream` | aichat | required | `/api/v1/ai-chat/[^/]+/stream\|/api/v1/ai-chat/message/[^/]+/regenerate-stream` | POST |

### `document:upload`

| Route id | Upstream | Auth | Path | Methods |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ai-recent-uploads` | content | required | `/api/v1/ai/recent-uploads` | all |
| `ai-upload` | document | required | `/api/v1/ai/(upload(/[^/]+)?\|quick-upload\|upload-image)` | all |
| `r2-image` | document | required | `/api/v1/r2/image` | POST |

### `wallet:use`

| Route id | Upstream | Auth | Path | Methods |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `payment` | finance | required | `/api/v1/payment*` | all |
| `wallet` | finance | required | `/api/v1/wallet*` | all |

### No gateway permission

The gateway only checks the token (`auth`); the service decides authorization with its own decorator.

| Route id | Upstream | Auth | Path | Methods |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `admin-logs-stream` | admin | none | `/api/v1/admin/logs/stream` | GET |
| `auth` | auth | required | `/api/v1/auth*` | all |
| `auth-public` | auth | none | `/api/v1/auth/(register\|login\|refresh\|send-code-reset-password\|reset-password\|google\|google/one-tap\|google/callback)` | all |
| `cheatinglogs` | assessment | required | `/api/v1/cheatinglogs*` | all |
| `config` | self | required | `/api/v1/config*` | all |
| `config-pages` | self | optional | `/api/v1/config/pages` | all |

## gRPC handler guards

Every Nest gRPC handler and its guard decorator (`ServiceOnly` lists the allowed service callers; `RequirePermissionsOrService` accepts a user token with the permissions, or a service token: from `callers` when given, any service when omitted, none for `callers: []`). The Python ai-service is not listed: its interceptor accepts service tokens only.

| Service | RPC | Guard | Source |

| AdminService | GetPageFlags | `@ServiceOnly('gateway')` | `apps/admin-service/src/modules/admin-page-config/admin-page-flags.grpc.controller.ts` |
